confidence_notes: I ran 5 web searches. One was for the RBA rate. Four covered Bangkok food and drink prices, including Numbeo/MyLifeElsewhere/Expat Arrivals-style aggregates and cocktail and wine price pages. The aggregates were crowdsourced and the figures differed between sources. I converted baht to USD at roughly 32 THB per USD, which is my own assumption. Restaurant meals and coffee are the best supported: an inexpensive meal is about THB 100-120, a cappuccino about THB 80-90, and a three-course mid-range meal for two about THB 1,200. Beer is less certain. Sources gave roughly THB 60 for a bottle and THB 85-90 for a pint or 500 ml, so I used a restaurant draft price of about THB 95. Cocktail and wine are based on the search results for Bangkok bar and hotel menus: about THB 300-450 per cocktail and THB 290-500 per glass of wine. Some of those sources were hotel menus or older pieces, and Bangkok menu prices often exclude about 17% service charge and tax. I did not search for accommodation. The four accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of Bangkok's typical registered hostel, guesthouse and 3-star ranges. They are not based on live listings. They are the least certain anchors and vary a lot by district and season. The July 2026 window was not checked directly, since the searches were run in November 2026.
comparable_city_reasoning: No other city was used as a comparable. The estimates rest on Bangkok-specific aggregated price data for food and drink, and on general knowledge of Bangkok's tourist-accommodation market.
